title: The company down the road
hook: Would a nearby headquarters change a fund manager's portfolio weight?

knows: basic arithmetic and reading a small table
doesNotKnow: Distinguish local geographic familiarity from national home-country preference.

misconception: The quantities in this case can be combined without checking their reference, denominator, or information boundary.
objective: Distinguish local geographic familiarity from national home-country preference.
keyState: Both complete computed cases are visible as retained observations; the question-case picture survives Reset.

claims.text: A toy portfolio puts 80% in one local group and 20% elsewhere. What is its sum-of-squared-shares concentration? Toy inputs A=[0.8, 0.2]; B=[0.5, 0.5].
claims.source: Local explicit hypothetical assumptions in spec.ts and model.ts; not participant measurements.

claims.text: Computed results: [[0.6800000000000002, 1, 0.8], [0.5, 1, 0.5]]. Labels: Concentration, Total share, Local share.
claims.source: compute() in the lesson-local model.ts; finite numeric operations over the explicit inputs.

claims.text: A location preference changes the portfolio’s weight concentration even when expected returns are held equal. The comparison balances the two groups. Concentration is a weight statistic, not proof that every local investment is a poor decision.
claims.source: The two controlled cases in spec.ts; scope limited to these toy inputs and displayed model rule.

claims.text: A new toy case uses Local share=0.5, Other share=0.5. What is Concentration? Answer: 0.5.
claims.source: compute() applied to the contrasting new input case; source list is an idea pointer only.

recall.question: A new toy case uses Local share=0.5, Other share=0.5. What is Concentration?
recall.why: Applying the stated toy rule to the new inputs gives 0.5. The result depends on these assumptions; it is not a universal behavioral response.

sourceProvenance.text: US fund managers overweight companies headquartered nearby (Coval & Moskowitz, 1999).
sourceProvenance.caveat: Original list says figures are approximate and papers were not individually rechecked. No empirical source is verified by this build.

meaningfulDifference: Distinguish local geographic familiarity from national home-country preference.
